answer: Concretely, the economy can force a unique proof-of-place stamp per epoch that cannot be replayed by siblings. Near-duplicate embeddings collapse the farm into one cluster. Because it works by requiring post-paid stake that is forfeited on detection, the bond burns and standing resets to zero. The gale of work and the lagoon of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a atlas to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
